correctness.rationale: For any strictly convex counterclockwise quadrilateral Q, its signed adjacent-three-vertex triangle areas c_i obey c0+c2=c1+c3=A. D=(c0-c2)^2+(c1-c3)^2≥0 vanishes iff opposite sides match a parallelogram. Via orientation-preserving affine coordinates v0=(0,0),v1=(1,0),v2=(s,h),v3=(0,1), with s,h>0 and s+h>1, A=(s+h)/2 and D=[(2−s−h)^2+(h−s)^2]/4. Rebuilding all four new vertices v′_i=v_i+u_i(v_{i+1}−v_i), with independent uniform u_i, the shoelace polynomial and corner determinants integrate exactly to E[A′|Q]=A/2, E[(A′)^2|Q]=(37/144)A²+(7/288)D, E[D′|Q]=(7/72)A²+(1/16)D. I independently reconstructed the symbolic 4-variable integrations from the geometry and verified all three identities exactly using SymPy, as well as the 2x2 characteristic polynomial with eigenvalues λ±=(23±7√5)/144. Matrix spectral decomposition gives coefficients C±=1/2±1/√5±δ/(4√5), δ=D0/A0², and the strictly positive fixed-area variance gap δ(λ+^t−λ-^t)/(4√5) for t>=1; equality precisely parallelograms. W_t=2^tA_t/A0 is a mean-one nonnegative martingale; E[W_t²] grows as ((23+7√5)/36)^t. Since Y=2A′/A∈(0,2), E[Y|Q]=1 and Var(Y|Q)=1/36+7D/(72A²)≥1/36, the elementary concavity bound E sqrt Y≤1−1/[72(1+sqrt2)^2] gives geometric decay of E sqrt W_t, implying W_t→0 a.s. by Markov and Borel–Cantelli. This proof does not infer almost-sure collapse merely from unbounded second moment.

value.rationale: The random independent-side subdivision process is established prior work. The new exact two-statistic quadratic moment closure, complete spectral formula, sharp parallelogram minimum variance and coexistence of martingale mean preservation with typical collapse and divergent second moment are natural, motivated quantitative facts for its four-sided case, beyond a routine deterministic midpoint identity or finite numerical table.

limitations: Only strictly convex planar four-gons with independent uniform side fractions at every step.
No statement about other sampling distributions, nonconvex polygons or complete distributional limit laws.
